item.description: You may have noticed that a lot of people on social media are getting really hot and bothered over the newly-elected Democratic men. It says a lot about how Democrats have responded to the Trump era.

item.title: Colorado flood victims hope for speedier federal help
item.description: Local and state officials in Colorado say recent floods have outstripped their ability to respond. They're worried about federal response after Trump delayed flood aid for political reasons in 2025.

item.title: Chicagoan-born Pope Leo returns to his second home Peru
item.description: This is a homecoming for Pope Leo who spent decades in the South American country before being called to Rome in 2023. He is a naturalized Peruvian citizen and often speaks Spanish with his followers.

item.title: Launch-ready, the Space Shuttle Endeavour goes back on display
item.description: The Space Shuttle Endeavour has been on display in California since 2012 — not long after NASA ended the program. Now, the California Science Center is showing off the shuttle in a new way.

item.description: First responders are still searching through the rubble of a three story apartment building that collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday, looking for any possible survivors.
